notes: Street names are printed without suffix in the big labels (CULVERT, PIKE, PIONEER, NEW); small labels and slips give Culvert St., Pike St., New St.; McAllister St. and Lawrence St. printed south of 5th. Culvert/7th: 7th ends where Culvert's north leg (N-S, x~2010) bends into its south-east diagonal leg; point is the centroid of the three centreline crossings (7th x N leg, 7th x SE leg, N x SE leg). Pioneer turns north-east at Pike (40 ft on the diagonal, 60 ft west of Pike); Pike/Pioneer point is at the bend. 5th turns north-east at the point where Pike (north leg, 40 ft) meets it (2862,4042, which also serves as 5th's bend); Pike St. south of 5th (about 60 ft) is offset and meets the diagonal leg of 5th at (2945,3962): two T's, first = north leg, second = south leg. 6th diagonal leg labelled 60'; NE of Culvert its SE side has a second line ~20 ft further out (probably sidewalk/lot line). Scott (printed 'Scott', 10') runs 6th to Pioneer; the 10 ft alley north of 6th to New (printed 'Alley') lines up with it, so 6th is a crossing. A 10 ft alley runs from 7th south to Chase Alley at the same x; between Chase and New the line continues only as a covered 'Passage' through buildings. Chase Alley (no width printed, ~9 ft) runs east from that alley and dead-ends at a wall at x~1712. Salmon Alley (west end at the New-6th alley) dead-ends at the Heekin buildings at x~1930. James Alley is enclosed, dead-ending at both ends (x 1497 and 1937). Broadway's block lines drift west down the sheet (centre ~527 at 7th to ~510 at 5th) while the water pipes stay at x~526. Pioneer, 7th, 6th, 5th, New: west of Broadway only Pioneer does not continue (block outline continuous), so Broadway/Pioneer is a T.
